projects.title: Sistem Skrining Tuberkulosis (CNN + Grad-CAM)
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end, web-based diagnostic tool to classify Chest X-Ray images for Tuberculosis screening using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with explainable AI visualization.
features: End-to-end web workflow from X-Ray upload to TB/Normal prediction
Transfer learning pipeline trained on 4,200 Kaggle chest X-ray images
Class imbalance handling for 700 TB vs 3,500 Normal cases
Grad-CAM heatmap visualization for model explainability
Interactive interface for medical screening support
projects.challenges: The main challenge was model bias risk due to significant class imbalance and ensuring predictions were interpretable for non-technical users.
projects.solution: Applied transfer learning with class-weighted training and robust validation strategy, then integrated Grad-CAM overlays in a Flask-based web app so clinicians can inspect regions influencing predictions.

projects.title: Pawspital - Manajemen Operasional Klinik Hewan
projects.description: Full-stack veterinary clinic management platform designed to digitalize pet owner registration, doctor consultations, medical records, prescription management, and educational content delivery with multi-role access control.
features: Multi-role authentication & authorization (Admin, Doctor, Author, User)
Patient registration: pet owner & animal information management
Medical records workflow: consultation scheduling, diagnosis, examination status
Prescription system: doctors generate prescriptions linked to inventory stock
CMS module: article authoring, categorization, public-facing blog
Master data management: animal types, specializations, inventory categories
Role-specific dashboards: operational insights for admin and doctors
projects.challenges: Designing a complex RBAC system that balances multiple stakeholder workflows (admin operations, doctor medical decisions, author content, user interactions) while ensuring data integrity across interconnected modules.
projects.solution: Implemented Laravel's authorization gates & policies, structured Inertia.js components per-role, established clear data boundaries via Eloquent relationships, and created unified UX patterns across CMS, medical, and inventory modules.
